title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you guys gonna sell out?
Al told me today he thought it was, but Colangelo hasn't gotten back to me

Yes I believe it will, eventually.  We've started to move them quickly over the last week. Tony Paul (who I normally like) loves to tweet about it, which is fine, but I don't think he understands the real issue. The issue isn't lack of demand. The issue was on the pricing side.  They tried to price it like an ALCS game and that isn't going to work anymore unless we are a bigtime contender.  If there is any story, it's that.  The last time we were a known non contender, the average price of an Opening day ticket was $20. Did you see what they started at this year? SROs were $75.
Yeah...but once they're up that high, they're not gonna push them way down
No way I would pay that to go watch this team in what everyone expected to be a crap day

No, and that is the problem. Once it starts high, you can't go back. If I didn't work here, there is no way I'd go in for more than $30. Otherwise, you keep the money in your pocket and go to the bar with it.
That's most of the allure of Opening Day in Detroit anyways

Yea of course. The demand was incredibly high for a decade or more but that's because we had a star laden club AND the tickets were priced like a regular game. You can't sell $41,000 tickets at an average of over $100, unless it's the World Series
